mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT b.attr_value_id, b.attr_id, b.attr_value, b.attr_value_name, b.attr_value_code, b.attr_value_desc, b.sortby, b.is_required, b.comp_type, a.attr_nbr AS "attrCode", a.attr_name FROM bt_skill_attr_spec a JOIN bt_skill_attr_value b ON b.attr_id = a.attr_id AND a.tenant_id = b.tenant_id WHERE a.status_cd = '00A' AND b.status_cd = '00A' AND a.attr_nbr = #{attrCode} AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY b.attr_id, b.sortby
